birch.line: This is the song for Baby Birch
stanza: This is the song for Baby Birch
I will never know you
And at the back of what we've done
There is the knowledge of you

church.line: A couple blocks from the orthodox church
stanza: “Of a Friday Night” also appears to refer to “The Alexandria Quartet”, a series…
Still in sight of the red lights
A couple blocks from the orthodox church
That's where the old poet lived
In his eyeglasses and his necktie
At the window looking down
On the young men passing by
On the fullness of the town
Take me to church
I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies
I'll tell you my sins and you can sharpen your knife
Offer me that deathless death
Oh, good God, let me give you my life
Take me to church
I'll worship like a dog at the shrine of your lies
I'll tell you my sins and you can sharpen your knife
Offer me that deathless death
Oh, good God, let me give you my life
Giving praise in a quiet way
Like a church
Like a church
Like a church
That's far away

search.line: Folks back home surely have called off the search
stanza: And the night so long
I used to pray for the daylight to come
Folks back home surely have called off the search
And gone back to their own

search.line: So many tears I was searching
stanza: So many tears I was searching
So many tears I was wasting, oh, oh
